coefficients.units: inverse metres at sea level; scale is an environmental control, not measured aerosol mass
coefficients.model: bulk hygroscopic radius growth and geometric-area extinction proxy; no Mie size-distribution solve

air.source: Shared scene sunlight after upper-atmosphere attenuation; local cloud/tree visibility once
air.integration: Quadratically spaced finite-distance analytic segments; half-res RGB scattering/transmission, depth-aware 4-neighbour reconstruction
limits: 8/6-step single scattering; no multiple-scattering or full atmospheric radiative transfer
Sky depth bypasses the pass to avoid duplicate sky extinction
Depth-edge fallback uses one midpoint; thin shadow boundaries may soften
No temporal random jitter/history; the pass does not hide motion with accumulation
Hygroscopic area growth is a prescribed aerosol proxy, not measured composition or a full Mie calculation
CPU submission time is not GPU cost or scene FPS
